name: reel
description: a batch of Okayville reels, brief to delivered; every stage leaves on evidence, frames and comedy read by someone other than the author

stages.name: plan
stages.exit: the brief, the branch and lane.json are written down

stages.name: build
stages.exit: every reel is built on the lane's branch, and a non-author read its frames at full size and scored its comedy at the floor or above

stages.name: merge
stages.exit: the lane's branch is in develop

stages.name: deliver
stages.exit: the publish check is clean with the batch delivered
